blocking_findings.location: run_child except/finally and collect qualification predicate
blocking_findings.finding: An owned child can finish with returncode 0 while parent attempt records error_class/interrupted; collect ignores these fields and can qualify the source and continue.
blocking_findings.required_change: A separately frozen helper/protocol must reject any recorded parent error or interruption; retain otherwise-successful interrupted-attempt fixture proving no subsequent dispatch.

other_reviewed_controls: exact host/commit/path list; no redirect/proxy/authentication handlers
per-file1MiB and aggregate4MiB retained-body reservations; incomplete receipt stops remaining requests
exclusive output and attempts; lstat/reparse/resolved containment checks
fixed isolated child argv, sanitized environment and EOF stdin pipe
bounded two-stream capture; owned process kill/reap and full-process cap check
fsynced partial progress/attempt/journal; failure marker vetoes prior clean report/receipt
post-receipt and post-lease aggregate deadline checks
limitations: Read-only source/pin review, not fetch execution or runtime attestation.
Retained body accounting is not measured network transfer.
A new root decision and exact v2 peer review remain required before requests.
